Brené Brown.name: Brené Brown
Brené Brown.early_revenue_description: Drew a University of Houston professor salary for 15 years while conducting her vulnerability and shame research.

Tony Robbins.name: Tony Robbins
Tony Robbins.early_revenue_description: Charged attendees modest fees to fill hotel conference rooms with NLP and personal development seminars starting at age 17.

Wim Hof.name: Wim Hof
Wim Hof.early_revenue_description: Worked odd jobs including postman and market trader while developing his breathing and cold exposure methods on his own.

Ali Abdaal.name: Ali Abdaal
Ali Abdaal.early_revenue_description: Worked as an NHS junior doctor while building his productivity YouTube channel on evenings and weekends.

Marie Forleo.name: Marie Forleo
Marie Forleo.early_revenue_description: Worked as a bartender and fitness instructor to pay rent while building her life coaching practice on the side.

James Clear.name: James Clear
James Clear.early_revenue_description: Ran a small photography business to cover expenses while publishing habit-focused essays on his blog twice a week.

Simon Sinek.name: Simon Sinek
Simon Sinek.early_revenue_description: Worked at an advertising agency while privately developing the Golden Circle framework and testing it in free talks.

Esther Perel.name: Esther Perel
Esther Perel.early_revenue_description: Ran a private couples therapy practice in NYC for over two decades, billing clients per session.

Adriene Mishler.name: Adriene Mishler
Adriene Mishler.early_revenue_description: Paid rent through acting gigs and yoga classes in Austin while uploading free yoga videos to YouTube on the side.

Gabor Mate.name: Gabor Mate
Gabor Mate.early_revenue_description: Drew a physician salary working as a family doctor in Vancouver for 20 years.

Glennon Doyle.name: Glennon Doyle
Glennon Doyle.early_revenue_description: Worked as a school teacher while writing personal essays on her Momastery blog for free.

Dave Ramsey.name: Dave Ramsey
Dave Ramsey.early_revenue_description: Taught his debt-elimination curriculum in church fellowship halls for $10 to $50 per head.

Myles Horton.name: Myles Horton
Myles Horton.early_revenue_description: Offered free civil rights workshops at Highlander Folk School, funded through foundation grants and donors.

Priya Parker.name: Priya Parker
Priya Parker.early_revenue_description: Hired directly by organizations as a conflict resolution facilitator, billing for her time.

Holly Whitaker.name: Holly Whitaker
Holly Whitaker.early_revenue_description: Worked a director-level role at One Medical while building Hip Sobriety as a blog and online program on the side.

Tenzin Palmo.name: Tenzin Palmo
Tenzin Palmo.early_revenue_description: Lived within the monastery system, then funded her nunnery through global donor fundraising rather than charging for teachings.

Elizabeth Gilbert.name: Elizabeth Gilbert
Elizabeth Gilbert.early_revenue_description: Paid rent through freelance magazine journalism for GQ, Spin, and NYT Magazine while working on personal writing.

Jay Shetty.name: Jay Shetty
Jay Shetty.early_revenue_description: Worked as a consultant at Accenture, producing motivational videos in spare time.

Phil Jackson.name: Phil Jackson
Phil Jackson.early_revenue_description: Drew an NBA player salary, then minor-league coaching salary while developing his Zen coaching philosophy.

John Gottman.name: John Gottman
John Gottman.early_revenue_description: Collected a University of Washington professor salary for decades while running the Love Lab research.

Alain de Botton.name: Alain de Botton
Alain de Botton.early_revenue_description: Earned publishing advances and royalties from philosophy books while building his public intellectual profile.

Bill Thomas.name: Bill Thomas
Bill Thomas.early_revenue_description: Drew a salary as a rural geriatrician employed by nursing homes in upstate New York.

Bill Wilson.name: Bill Wilson
Bill Wilson.early_revenue_description: Ran AA meetings as a volunteer while his wife worked at a department store.

Dan Hughes.name: Dan Hughes
Dan Hughes.early_revenue_description: Billed per session as a clinical psychologist treating traumatized children in private practice.

David Bohm.name: David Bohm
David Bohm.early_revenue_description: Drew a physics professor salary at Princeton, then Bristol and Birkbeck.

Ella Baker.name: Ella Baker
Ella Baker.early_revenue_description: Received a paid field organizer salary from the NAACP.

Erin Gruwell.name: Erin Gruwell
Erin Gruwell.early_revenue_description: Paid a public school teacher salary, supplementing with extra jobs to buy classroom books.

Fela Kuti.name: Fela Kuti
Fela Kuti.early_revenue_description: Charged admission for near-nightly performances at his Lagos club, The Shrine.

Gabby Bernstein.name: Gabby Bernstein
Gabby Bernstein.early_revenue_description: Worked in PR while teaching spirituality workshops in living rooms and bars.

Gloria Steinem.name: Gloria Steinem
Gloria Steinem.early_revenue_description: Earned freelance journalism fees while building her activist platform.

Gordon Lish.name: Gordon Lish
Gordon Lish.early_revenue_description: Drew an editor salary at Esquire, then Knopf, while running private fiction workshops.

Grace Lee Boggs.name: Grace Lee Boggs
Grace Lee Boggs.early_revenue_description: Lived frugally on her husband's autoworker wages while doing unpaid community organizing.

Harville Hendrix.name: Harville Hendrix
Harville Hendrix.early_revenue_description: Charged per-session fees as a clinical therapist before packaging insights into Imago workshops.

Jesse Itzler.name: Jesse Itzler
Jesse Itzler.early_revenue_description: Generated income as a rapper and jingle writer before cold-calling into aviation.

Jose Andres.name: Jose Andres
Jose Andres.early_revenue_description: Drew a chef wage working in DC restaurant kitchens before opening his own restaurants.

Joseph Campbell.name: Joseph Campbell
Joseph Campbell.early_revenue_description: Drew a professor salary from Sarah Lawrence College for 38 years.

Kae Tempest.name: Kae Tempest
Kae Tempest.early_revenue_description: Earned performance fees at London spoken word venues and UK festivals.

Luciano Pavarotti.name: Luciano Pavarotti
Luciano Pavarotti.early_revenue_description: Taught primary school full-time while training as an opera singer.

Marc Freedman.name: Marc Freedman
Marc Freedman.early_revenue_description: Drew a nonprofit executive salary from Experience Corps and Civic Ventures.

Marshall Ganz.name: Marshall Ganz
Marshall Ganz.early_revenue_description: Received a paid organizer salary from the United Farm Workers for 16 years.

Lin-Manuel Miranda.name: Lin-Manuel Miranda
Lin-Manuel Miranda.early_revenue_description: Worked as a substitute teacher and took freelance music gigs while writing In the Heights over six years.

Martti Ahtisaari.name: Martti Ahtisaari
Martti Ahtisaari.early_revenue_description: Drew a Finnish government and UN salary as a diplomat for decades.

Marva Collins.name: Marva Collins
Marva Collins.early_revenue_description: Taught in Chicago public schools for 14 years, used $5,000 of her pension to start Westside Prep.

Mercedes Sosa.name: Mercedes Sosa
Mercedes Sosa.early_revenue_description: Performed at intimate folk gatherings and regional festivals across Argentina for modest fees.

Nina Simone.name: Nina Simone
Nina Simone.early_revenue_description: Played piano nightly at the Midtown Bar and Grill in Atlantic City to fund classical training.

P.T. Barnum.name: P.T. Barnum
P.T. Barnum.early_revenue_description: Ran a newspaper, lottery, and boarding house before pivoting into entertainment.

Paulo Freire.name: Paulo Freire
Paulo Freire.early_revenue_description: Held a university appointment at the University of Recife while running adult literacy programmes.

Rita Pierson.name: Rita Pierson
Rita Pierson.early_revenue_description: Spent 40 years on a public school teacher salary.

Stan Tatkin.name: Stan Tatkin
Stan Tatkin.early_revenue_description: Ran a private couples therapy practice in LA while developing PACT.

Sue Johnson.name: Sue Johnson
Sue Johnson.early_revenue_description: Held a clinical psychology faculty position at the University of Ottawa.

Tarana Burke.name: Tarana Burke
Tarana Burke.early_revenue_description: Worked as a youth worker drawing a nonprofit salary in Selma, Alabama.

Terry Real.name: Terry Real
Terry Real.early_revenue_description: Maintained a full private therapy practice charging per-session fees in Boston.

Tiffany Aliche.name: Tiffany Aliche
Tiffany Aliche.early_revenue_description: Kept her preschool teaching job while building The Budgetnista as a side project.

Václav Havel.name: Václav Havel
Václav Havel.early_revenue_description: Earned royalties and fees from theatre productions at the Theatre on the Balustrade in Prague.

Walt Disney.name: Walt Disney
Walt Disney.early_revenue_description: Took commercial illustration jobs while building his animation venture on the side.

William Shakespeare.name: William Shakespeare
William Shakespeare.early_revenue_description: Earned wages as a working actor and shareholder, splitting ticket receipts from paid performances at the Globe.

Yayoi Kusama.name: Yayoi Kusama
Yayoi Kusama.early_revenue_description: Sold paintings to collectors in New York's avant-garde gallery scene, living in poverty.

Tara Brach.name: Tara Brach
Tara Brach.early_revenue_description: Maintained a private clinical psychology practice while leading meditation gatherings.

Eckhart Tolle.name: Eckhart Tolle
Eckhart Tolle.early_revenue_description: Taught German and Spanish at a London language school. Gave private spiritual counseling sessions on the side before self-publishing The Power of Now in 1997.

Deepak Chopra.name: Deepak Chopra
Deepak Chopra.early_revenue_description: Practiced as a licensed endocrinologist for years before pivoting to Ayurvedic medicine after meeting Maharishi Mahesh Yogi in 1985.

Jack Kornfield.name: Jack Kornfield
Jack Kornfield.early_revenue_description: Joined the Peace Corps after Dartmouth, then ordained as a Buddhist monk in Thailand. Co-founded Insight Meditation Society in 1975 and Spirit Rock in 1988.

Sam Harris.name: Sam Harris
Sam Harris.early_revenue_description: Completed a PhD in cognitive neuroscience at UCLA while writing. Published The End of Faith in 2004, funded by academic work and book advances.

Thich Nhat Hanh.name: Thich Nhat Hanh
Thich Nhat Hanh.early_revenue_description: Ordained as a monk at 16 in Vietnam. Lived within monastic institutions his entire life, supported by the sangha and later by Plum Village community.

Seane Corn.name: Seane Corn
Seane Corn.early_revenue_description: Waitressed at Life Cafe in the East Village while building her yoga teaching practice. Moved to LA and grew through word of mouth.

Joe Dispenza.name: Joe Dispenza
Joe Dispenza.early_revenue_description: Ran a chiropractic practice for years. After healing his own broken spine through meditation, began incorporating mind-body work into his clinical practice.

Aubrey Marcus.name: Aubrey Marcus
Aubrey Marcus.early_revenue_description: Ran a marketing company, then founded Onnit supplements in 2010. Used his podcast and Joe Rogan's endorsement to build the brand.

Ram Dass.name: Ram Dass
Ram Dass.early_revenue_description: Harvard psychology professor until fired in 1963. Lived off savings and donations while traveling to India. Gave away all royalties from Be Here Now.

Sadhguru.name: Sadhguru
Sadhguru.early_revenue_description: Ran poultry farms, a construction business, and a brickworks in his 20s. Founded Isha Foundation in 1992, teaching yoga for free to anyone who showed up.

Marianne Williamson.name: Marianne Williamson
Marianne Williamson.early_revenue_description: Ran a metaphysical bookshop in Houston, sang cabaret. Moved to LA and began lecturing weekly on A Course in Miracles, building a loyal following.

Mooji.name: Mooji
Mooji.early_revenue_description: Worked as a street artist in London doing charcoal portraits. After meeting Papaji in India in 1993, began giving free satsangs when seekers gathered.

Yung Pueblo.name: Yung Pueblo
Yung Pueblo.early_revenue_description: Worked various jobs after getting clean from drugs through Vipassana in 2012. Began posting plain text poems on Instagram in 2015 while working.

Sahara Rose.name: Sahara Rose
Sahara Rose.early_revenue_description: After healing her own health crisis through Ayurveda at 21, cold-emailed Deepak Chopra and began writing. Published Idiot's Guide to Ayurveda at 26, funded by book advances.

Sri Sri Ravi Shankar.name: Sri Sri Ravi Shankar
Sri Sri Ravi Shankar.early_revenue_description: After developing Sudarshan Kriya, taught it for free through volunteer-run Art of Living courses. The foundation operates on donations and course fees.

Vishen Lakhiani.name: Vishen Lakhiani
Vishen Lakhiani.early_revenue_description: Started selling other people's meditation courses online from a Starbucks in New York with $700. Used Google Ads and email marketing to bootstrap Mindvalley.

Michael Singer.name: Michael Singer
Michael Singer.early_revenue_description: Went into seclusion in the Florida woods after a spiritual awakening at 24. Founded Temple of the Universe as a free meditation center. Accidentally built a billion-dollar software company by saying yes to opportunities.

Michael Beckwith.name: Michael Beckwith
Michael Beckwith.early_revenue_description: Started Agape International with a small prayer group in his living room in 1986. Grew through word of mouth and weekly consistency for 20 years.

Radha Agrawal.name: Radha Agrawal
Radha Agrawal.early_revenue_description: After losing her company to a hostile takeover, threw the first Daybreaker sober morning dance party with a $2,500 budget. 180 friends showed up. Bootstrapped to a seven-figure business.

Meghan Pappenheim.name: Meghan Pappenheim
Meghan Pappenheim.early_revenue_description: Moved to Bali at 20, built an online community directory. Opened The Yoga Barn in 2007 with two studios, growing through grassroots community building.

Jeff Krasno.name: Jeff Krasno
Jeff Krasno.early_revenue_description: Co-founded a record label (Velour Recordings) in NYC. After watching his wife's yoga retreats, combined event production skills with wellness to create Wanderlust festival.

Gabrielle Roth.name: Gabrielle Roth
Gabrielle Roth.early_revenue_description: After a knee injury ended her dance career, began teaching movement at Esalen. Spent a decade experimenting with what became the 5Rhythms method in small groups.

Larry Harvey.name: Larry Harvey
Larry Harvey.early_revenue_description: Worked as a landscaper in Portland. Burned an 8-foot wooden man on Baker Beach in 1986 with about 20 friends. Kept showing up until 80,000 people did too.
